verified_facts.text: The hotel sits by the Mediterranean Sea, Neve Tzedek and Old Jaffa.
verified_facts.excerpt: Nestled by the Mediterranean Sea, Neve Tzedek, and Old Jaffa, InterContinental David Tel Aviv brings modern elegance to the Nonstop City.

verified_facts.text: More than 90% of the rooms have Mediterranean Sea views.
verified_facts.excerpt: More than 90% of our rooms feature breathtaking Mediterranean Sea views

verified_facts.text: The Tayelet, Tel Aviv's beachfront promenade from Tel Aviv Port to Jaffa, is steps from the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: stretches 14 km from the lively Tel Aviv Port to historic Jaffa. Joggers, cyclists, café lovers, and sunset seekers gather here, just steps from your sanctuary at InterContinental David Tel Aviv.

verified_facts.text: The outdoor pool has Mediterranean views.
verified_facts.excerpt: Lounge by our sparkling pool with stunning Mediterranean views.

verified_facts.text: The MAYIM pool bar serves light snacks and cocktails.
verified_facts.excerpt: a light snack or a cocktail from the MAYIM pool bar.

verified_facts.text: A kids' pool offers a shaded, secure play area.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our kids’ pool offers a shaded and secure play area for your little ones.

verified_facts.text: THE Spa has seven treatment rooms, including a couples' suite, plus saunas and a relaxation space.
verified_facts.excerpt: THE Spa boasts seven treatment rooms including a luxury couples’ suite, saunas, and a relaxation space.

verified_facts.text: The Club InterContinental lounge is on the 24th floor with views of the Mediterranean Sea.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located on the 24th floor of the hotel with breathtaking views of the Mediterranean Sea, Club InterContinental is the ultimate private urban haven.

verified_facts.text: The Club lounge offers check-in and check-out, breakfast, afternoon tea, all-day refreshments and evening drinks with canapes.
verified_facts.excerpt: it offers check-in and check-out services, breakfast, afternoon tea, all-day refreshments, and evening drinks with canapés

verified_facts.text: Rooms have marble bathrooms, a work desk and a sitting area.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our spacious rooms are warmly decorated, with relaxing bedding, marble bathrooms, a work desk and a sitting area.

verified_facts.text: Terrace rooms have sea views from generous private balconies.
verified_facts.excerpt: Terrace rooms boast sea views from generous private balconies.

verified_facts.text: The Atrium Lobby Bar sits in the middle of a spacious lobby with 27-meter-high ceilings.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located in the middle of our spectacular and spacious lobby with 27 meters of high ceilings, the Atrium Bar boasts impressive architecture.

verified_facts.text: Pastries by Alon Shabo, one of Israel's leading pastry chefs, are served at the Atrium Lobby Bar.
verified_facts.excerpt: Discover the creations of Alon Shabo, one of Israel’s leading pastry chefs, now available at our Atrium Lobby Bar.

verified_facts.text: SPICE is a cocktail bar with a vintage ambiance inspired by an old world apothecary.
verified_facts.excerpt: Step into SPICE, our sophisticated cocktail bar offering an elegant and vintage ambiance inspired by the aesthetics of an old world apothecary.

verified_facts.text: Jaffa Court's Israeli breakfast includes salads, local cheeses, shakshuka, and smoked and pickled fish.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy fresh salads, local cheeses, breads, pastries, egg dishes like shakshuka, and smoked and pickled fish.

verified_facts.text: Young travelers have a dedicated check-in area at reception and welcome amenities.
verified_facts.excerpt: Young travelers can enjoy a dedicated check-in area at our reception and special welcome amenities tailored just for them.

verified_facts.text: Large connecting rooms are available for families.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our large connecting rooms provide ample space for the whole family to relax and unwind.

verified_facts.text: Guests can enjoy Adanim Tea, a family-owned Israeli tea house crafting organic blends since 1982.
verified_facts.excerpt: guests can enjoy Adanim Tea, a family-owned Israeli tea house crafting organic blends since 1982.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is at 12 Kaufman Street, Tel Aviv.
verified_facts.excerpt: 12 Kaufman Street Tel Aviv, 61501 Israel

verified_facts.text: Ben Gurion Airport (TLV) is about 20 kilometers from the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: Ben Gurion Airport (TLV), approximately 12.43 miles away (20 kilometers) from the hotel

verified_facts.text: The pool is open seasonally.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our pool is open seasonally.

verified_facts.text: Neve Tzedek, the Carmel Market and Jaffa are close by.
verified_facts.excerpt: From beaches and Neve Tzedek to The Carmel Market, and ancient charm of Jaffo, Tel Aviv offers a nonstop adventure.

verified_facts.text: Kids' activities at the hotel are seasonal.
verified_facts.excerpt: Create unforgettable family memories with a range of seasonal kids' activities and spacious pool facilities.
